name: "Peach Crescendo" Full Flower Craft Pre-Roll - 1g
description:
"Peach Crescendo builds in layers—starting soft and juicy with ripe stone fruit, then rising into sharper notes of sour tang and high-octane gas. Each inhale is a slow climb from sun-warmed sweetness to something louder, brighter, and just a little unruly.
The peach hits first: lush, golden, almost creamy. Then comes the twist—citrus bite, fermenting fruit, and a streak of sharp fuel that cuts through like feedback at the peak of a song. The effect is dynamic, shifting, and never flat. Peach Crescendo doesn’t settle—it swells, it stirs, and it leaves you humming long after the smoke clears."
